content.short: Kizzy is a mobile app for over-under bets on YouTube and X creator metrics.
content.description: Kizzy is a social media betting app on Monad where users take positions on the popularity of influencers and individual pieces of content. Markets resolve against engagement metrics, so the payout depends on how a post or creator actually performs. Alongside creator markets the app carries casino-style games.
content.meta: Over-under markets on creator statistics, settled from public platform data.
